title: Arctic Berry E-Liquid 60ml (3000mg)
description:
Introducing our Premium Arctic Berry CBD E Liquid: a fusion of mixed berries and menthol for an exhilarating vaping experience. Crafted with precision, this premium e-liquid delivers a refreshing burst of flavor. Derived from organic hemp, our high-quality CBD ensures purity and potency, offering a natural way to relax
Our premium CBD E liquids boast an 80% PG (Propylene Glycol) and 20% VG (Vegetable Glycerin) composition, ensuring a smooth and satisfying vaping experience.
